blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Land Transportation Office (LTO) impounded an imported electric vehicle (EV) in Quezon City on Friday. The apprehension comes after its driver was caught using a fake license. The motorist also failed to present the vehicle’s registration documents. The vehicle was also found to be on the road without a license plate. The unit impounded was an Onvo L90 electric crossover utility vehicle which is manufactured by Chinese car maker Nio Inc. It was flagged down during a joint law enforcement checkpoint along Boni Serrano Avenue in Quezon City. The action was conducted by the LTO’s Law Enforcement Service (LES), […]...
